The '''Firro system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Farrfin sector/Legends|Farrfin sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Firro]].
